goal: Verify that a user can successfully register as a Site Host and subsequently access the content creation menu by clicking the plus button.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field.
Click the blue 'Sign up' button to complete the registration.
Once logged into the dashboard, locate the text input area labeled 'Any thoughts...' at the bottom of the screen.
Click the small '+' (plus) icon located inside the text input area to open the content options menu.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the registration page to the main dashboard view.
The dashboard displays the 'Memos' interface with a calendar and sidebar navigation.
Clicking the '+' icon opens a dropdown menu containing options such as 'Media', 'Record audio', 'File', and 'Link memo'.
No error messages are displayed during the account creation or menu interaction process.
